name: winter_forest
_about: Level 4 Winter Forest: pink-amber dusk, ice-blue mountains, snow-laden dark pines and a clear snow floor.
Build with scripts/build_layer_set.py. Layer order is draw order; the ground precedes the forest.
Generations and sidecars are in build/art/winter_forest/. All used gemini-3.1-flash-image, 4:1, 4K, without references.
No seam waivers, flattening or feathering. Prompt revisions are archived rather than overwritten.
Clouds v1 and v2 variant 1 had duplicate rows or graded keys; v2 variant 2 has six complete clouds and intentional empty margins.
Forest v1-v3 failed on clipped tips, repeated groups or mismatched rock feet. v4 replaces rock feet with continuous snow hummocks.
The first v4 sweep had clipped trees or purple stains; the refinement damaged another tree. The second sweep's third roll is the keeper.
The forest snow continues into the floor, so it has no contact shadow: a shadow along that material join would draw an artificial stripe.
